name: ytcc-meetings
title: ytcc Meetings
description: Record meetings and transcribe them locally with ytcc
author: macromogic

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Meeting Recorder
commands.subtitle: ytcc
commands.description: Shows the recording state and offers to record when an app is using the microphone

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Meeting Recording
commands.subtitle: ytcc
commands.description: Record the microphone and the call audio

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Meeting Recording
commands.subtitle: ytcc
commands.description: Stop recording and transcribe in the background

preferences.name: summarize
preferences.title: Summary
preferences.label: Summarize with Claude after transcribing
preferences.description: Runs `claude -p`, which sends the transcript to Anthropic. Transcription itself stays local.

preferences.name: notify
preferences.title: Meeting detection
preferences.label: Notify when an app starts using the microphone
preferences.description: The menu bar item always shows it; this also sends a notification.

preferences.name: ytccPath
preferences.title: ytcc command
preferences.description: Empty: look up ytcc and PATH in your login shell
